Fixed `graph.py`:

- Deduplicates on the full `(head, relation, tail)` triple, so distinct relations between the same head/tail are all preserved while exact duplicate declarations are dropped.
- `get_neighbors(entity)` now iterates over all stored triples and returns each incident relationship exactly once as `{"head", "relation", "tail"}`.
- Public API unchanged; public tests pass.
